description: Pay-per-call API merchant settled in Nano (XNO). Endpoints: web extract, link checker, batch URL health, URL status, domain intelligence, web search, geoip lookup, nano account info, YouTube transcript, PDF text extraction, screenshot capture, browser-rendered page text, CSS-selector field extraction, page metadata (OpenGraph/JSON-LD), HTML table extraction, AI-jobs search, wiki summary, arxiv paper, and MCP/x402 service finder. No signup, no api keys.

intents.name: extract_url
intents.description: Extract clean text/markdown from any URL. Returns title, text content, and markdown version.

intents.name: check_link
intents.description: Check HTTP status, response time, and redirect chain for any URL.

intents.name: url_status
intents.description: One-call URL status: final HTTP status, redirect chain, TLS validity and days-to-expiry, response time, and whether the body changed (?previous_hash=).

previous_hash.description: sha256 of the body from an earlier call, to detect content drift

intents.name: domain_intel
intents.description: Full domain investigation: DNS records, WHOIS, SSL/TLS certificate, HTTP headers.

intents.name: web_search
intents.description: Search the web via DuckDuckGo. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets.

intents.name: neural_search
intents.description: Semantic web search: retrieve candidates then rank by cosine similarity to your natural-language query, returning the most on-topic results first with a relevance score and matched excerpt.

intents.name: geoip_lookup
intents.description: Look up IP geolocation: country, city, coordinates, ISP, ASN, timezone.

intents.name: mcp_find
intents.description: Search paid MCP/x402 service directories for a task, returning services with their settlement rails, prices and x402 health.

q.description: Task to find a service for

filter_rail.description: Rail filter, e.g. 'nano' for XNO-settling services

intents.name: nano_account
intents.description: Nano account intelligence: balance, representative, block count, frontier, weight, pending transactions.

intents.name: youtube_transcript
intents.description: Extract captions and transcript from a YouTube video URL. Returns timestamped segments and model-sized chunks.

intents.name: screenshot_capture
intents.description: Capture a full-page or viewport screenshot of any public URL using headless browser rendering. Returns a base64 data URL.

intents.name: render_page
intents.description: Render a JavaScript-heavy page in a real browser and return its content as Markdown. Use when a plain HTTP fetch returns an empty shell (SPAs, dashboards, client-rendered search results).

intents.name: balance_topup
intents.description: Deposit XNO to prepaid balance via X-PAYMENT header. Full amount credited to sender. Draw from balance on subsequent calls via X-BALANCE header.

intents.name: pdf_extract
intents.description: Extract text from a PDF at a URL, preserving page structure. Essential for papers, specs, reports and invoices that a normal web extractor cannot read.

url.description: URL of a PDF to extract text from
